Label: Heating and Cooking
Description: Unsafe arrangement of heating including chimneys, stovepipes and gas vents and unsafe arrangement of cooking devices.

Label: Wiring
Description: Unsafe or inadequate electric wiring, non-standard extensions, overloading, overfusing.

Label: Conversion
Description: Subdivision or conversion of original living spaces into multiple units with overcrowded occupancy.

Label: Physical Condition and Housekeeping
Description: Building not in good repair, roof or chimneys deteriorating, wood surfaces unpainted or decaying, garages or porches not well maintained and yards, basements, hallways or attics not kept clean and free from rubbish and litter.

Label: Exposure
Description: For adjoining properties of an exceptionally hazardous nature.
